:::{#hero}
Grabbing reality by the data
:::

I lead the Advanced Data Analysis unit at the [Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine](https://gimm.pt), where my team brings statistical rigor and machine learning to biology: experimental design, Bayesian inference, multi-omics data integration, and the honest analysis of single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

I am increasingly interested in how AI changes the practice of science itself: agentic systems for data analysis, foundation models for biology, and what it takes to make AI-generated analysis trustworthy rather than merely fast. I write about this on the [blog](blog.qmd), and build tools under [Projects](projects.qmd).
